description: This file is a shell script intended to set up the 'linux_binder_idl' tools. It defines paths, functions to clone a repository, modify environment variables, and verify installation, and executes these steps to prepare the environment for binder tool usage.

methods.name: clone_repo
methods.description: Clones the linux_binder_idl repository if it is not already cloned into the specified installation directory.

methods.name: setup_path
methods.description: Checks if the binder tools directory is in the PATH and provides instructions to add it if not.

methods.name: verify_installation
methods.description: Verifies if the 'binder' command is available, indicating successful installation.

methods.name: check_sourced
methods.description: Checks if the script is being sourced rather than executed and provides a warning.
